explore-distance.title: Step back
explore-distance.prompt: Move the person back until they're outside the exposure zone.
hints: It's a few metres: keep going.
explore-distance.success: About 7 m away the power density drops below this example limit. That's why beams go up high, above people's heads.

explore-double.title: Double the distance
explore-double.prompt: Note the power density at 2 m, then move to 4 m.
explore-double.success: Twice the distance, a quarter of the power density: about 20 W/m² down to 5 W/m².
